tACK 1ad8b857fa76ec5c8173fe41db2fcdd998bf3e9d

I built `test_bitcoin` at this commit and ran the new test 20 times; it passed every time and does not depend on timing. It fails with both mutants from the description, and with both `return true`s removed together, which brings back the pre-#15644 behaviour of handling every orphan in one call. It also catches dropping `if (processed_orphan) return true;` in `ProcessMessages`.

One related mutant survives: removing `if (m_txdownloadman.HaveMoreWork(peer.m_id)) fMoreWork = true;` from `ProcessMessages`. Orphan processing then starts only on the peer's next poll, up to 100 ms later. The two suggestions below kill it, and the test still passes. This is a delay, not the CVE, so it is optional.
Thanks for the reviews! Force-pushed aba1cd975c1e5d3db7bb65d1e6c9cd7d918b2be4 adding the suggestions on https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36262#pullrequestreview-5391424947

comments.body:
Return the result, so the test can check it when the parent is sent.
```suggestion
        return connman.ProcessMessagesOnce(peer);
```

This fails if `ProcessMessages` stops signalling more work once the parent is accepted.
```suggestion
    BOOST_CHECK(send_tx(parent));
```
